name: Mughlai Shahi Sheermal
alt: Golden saffron-brushed Mughlai Shahi Sheermal flatbread with sesame seeds with ZaikaWorlds logo
desc: Fragrant saffron-infused sweet milk flatbread baked golden, enriched with cardamom, pure desi ghee, and a glossy saffron glaze.
intro: Sheermal is a regal Persian-Mughlai flatbread traditionally paired with Nihari and Korma. Made by kneading fine flour exclusively with warm sweetened milk, rich ghee, and mawa, it is brushed lavishly with saffron milk before baking to a heavenly golden crust.
ing: Saffron threads soaked in 3 tbsp warm milk 1 pinch
White sesame seeds for topping 1 tbsp
steps: Dissolve sugar and yeast in warm milk; allow to froth for 8 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, cardamom powder, and melted ghee; rub together until breadcrumb consistency.
Pour yeast milk and kewra water into flour; knead into a smooth, supple, soft dough for 10 minutes.
Cover and let dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide into 4 smooth balls, roll each into an 8-inch disc of medium thickness, and prick gently with a fork.
Generously brush top with rich saffron milk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, or cook on a heavy tawa until puffed and golden brown with blistered saffron spots.
Brush with warm melted desi ghee immediately upon removing from heat.
tip: Pricking the surface with a fork or traditional roti pricker prevents the sheermal from ballooning up like a puri, keeping its soft bread-like crumb intact.

ru.name: Mughlai Shahi Sheermal
ru.desc: Zafran aur doodh se bani naram meethi shahi sheermal roti.

name: Royal Shahi Rasmalai
alt: Soft cottage cheese patties soaked in saffron cardamom rabri with ZaikaWorlds logo
desc: Delicate melt-in-mouth milk cheese dumplings poached softly in sweet reduced saffron milk, garnished with pistachios and silver leaf.
intro: Rasmalai translates to 'juice of cream' and represents the pinnacle of subcontinent confectionary. Spongy handmade milk cheese patties soak in a silky reduced milk bath infused with green cardamom, Kashmiri saffron strands, and crushed emerald pistachios.
ing: Full cream milk for rabri 1 liter
Dry milk powder (nido or everyday) 1 cup
Crushed pistachios and slivered almonds 3 tbsp
steps: In a wide pot, simmer 1 liter milk with sugar, crushed cardamoms, and saffron on medium heat for 20 minutes until reduced by one-third into a fragrant rabri.
In a bowl, mix milk powder, baking powder, and flour; rub in melted ghee.
Gradually add whisked egg and knead lightly into a soft, slightly sticky dough (do not over-knead).
Immediately shape dough into 12 small smooth crack-free oval patties (they will double in size when cooked).
Gently drop patties into the actively simmering rabri milk one by one.
Cover pot tightly with a lid and cook on medium flame for 10 minutes without opening to allow steam to puff the dumplings.
Remove lid, gently turn each patty with a spoon, and simmer uncovered for 3 more minutes.
Remove from heat, chill thoroughly in refrigerator for at least 4 hours, and garnish with crushed pistachios before serving cold.
tip: Shape and cook the patties immediately after kneading; if the dough sits on the counter, it dries out and causes cracks in the dumplings.

name: Authentic Kashmiri Rogan Josh
alt: Vibrant deep-red Kashmiri Rogan Josh mutton curry in brass bowl with ZaikaWorlds logo
desc: Aromatic slow-braised Kashmiri mutton curry steeped in fennel, dry ginger (soonth), Kashmiri red chilies, and whole spices.
intro: Rogan Josh is an iconic cornerstone of Kashmiri Wazwan cuisine. Tender bone-in lamb or mutton is braised in an intensely aromatic sauce infused with fennel seed powder, sun-dried ginger, and Kashmiri chilies for an unmatchable crimson luster without fiery heat.
ing: Black cardamom 2, green cardamom 4, cloves 4, cinnamon stick 1
steps: Heat mustard oil in a heavy pot until smoking point; turn off heat briefly to cool, then return to medium flame.
Add whole whole spices and a pinch of hing; immediately add mutton pieces and sear on high heat until lightly browned.
Mix Kashmiri chili powder with 2 tbsp water into a paste; add to mutton and stir vigorously to coat every piece in brilliant red color.
Lower heat, add whisked yogurt gradually while stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Stir in fennel powder, ginger powder, and salt; cook for 10 minutes until oil separates.
Add 2 cups warm water, bring to boil, cover tightly, and simmer on gentle heat for 60 minutes until meat is butter-soft.
Cook uncovered for final 5 minutes until gravy is thick, silky, and glistening with royal red oil (rogan).
tip: Traditional Kashmiri Rogan Josh never uses onions, tomatoes, or garlic; the entire body of the gravy comes from yogurt, fennel powder, and dry ginger.

ru.name: Authentic Kashmiri Rogan Josh
ru.desc: Asal Kashmiri zafrani laal rogan josh mutton salan.
